claims.full_proposition: Within the declared reporting-adult, present-enactment domain, H_way is a selected target concerning the familiar felt character of the current bodily manner. O_self, K_practice, A_control, and E_ease are not definitions of that target, although they may overlap or covary with it.
claims.domain: Specified presently enacted actions in reporting-capable adults; no universal psychological taxonomy.
claims.support: Conceptual distinction plus proxy-reversal vignettes; neighbouring primary studies operationalize distinct recognition/observation constructs.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: No vignette proves empirical independence or assigns H_way truth. Strong covariance in a population remains possible.

claims.full_proposition: S_H is a four-part content gate requiring present-enactment applicability, a target-directed paraphrase, no declared proxy-substitution rule across held-out vignettes, and response-code invariance.
claims.domain: Pre-result item interpretation in the same declared participant/action domain.
claims.support: Protocol construction and construct-validity boundary in the agency measurement literature.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: A strategic or memorizing responder can pass; PASS is not truth, sincerity, or reliability.

claims.full_proposition: For any finite semantic battery V with accepted answer vector a and unrestricted response policies, a lookup policy pi_V can reproduce a on every probe without depending on H_way on later target trials. Therefore S_H alone does not entail a signed truth-tracking relation C_H from J_H to H_way.
claims.domain: Finite probe batteries and unrestricted response-policy classes.
premises: the response-policy class permits finite lookup
later H_way assignments are not fixed by V
claims.proof: Construct pi_V(v_i)=a_i. Hold V, a, and pi_V fixed in two admissible worlds while varying later H_way. Observed semantic-pass data are identical, so calibration is not identified.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: Restricted causal models, independent convergent measures, interventions, or justified response constraints may supply calibration. The claim is not that all calibration is impossible.

claims.full_proposition: An H_way-level organizational comparison requires S_H AND C_H AND O_H on the declared domain and same episodes. S_H is semantic admissibility, C_H is independently justified signed judgement-to-experience reliability, and O_H is actual same-instance retained-route/use and fit evidence.
claims.domain: Prospective A3W/FAM application only; not a completed UCT graph rule.
premises: content, truth-tracking, and physical instantiation are different evidential roles
all three must concern the declared comparison domain
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: S_H alone leaves C_H and O_H open; S_H plus C_H still leaves actual organization open.
